mapper.insert: INSERT INTO link_cache_outbox (code, status, available_at, attempts, last_error, processed_at) VALUES (#{param1}, 'PENDING', NOW(), 0, NULL, NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'PENDING', available_at = NOW(), attempts = 0, last_error = NULL, processed_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT code, attempts FROM link_cache_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= NOW() ORDER BY available_at ASC LIMIT #{param1}
mapper.update: UPDATE link_cache_outbox SET status = 'DONE', processed_at = NOW(), last_error = NULL WHERE code = #{param1}
UPDATE link_cache_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', attempts = #{param2}, last_error = #{param3}, processed_at = NULL, available_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{param4} SECOND) WHERE code = #{param1}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM link_cache_outbox WHERE status = 'DONE' AND processed_at IS NOT NULL AND processed_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{param1} DAY) LIMIT #{param2}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status = 'PENDING'), 0) AS pending_total, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= NOW()), 0) AS pending_ready, COALESCE( GREATEST( 0, TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN available_at END), NOW() ) ), 0 ) AS pending_lag_seconds FROM link_cache_outbox
SELECT status FROM link_cache_outbox WHERE code = #{param1} LIMIT 1
